file_id: Nandeepak Dayal Patade vs The Commissioner Of Police And Ors on 1 December, 2025

sentences.text:
Nandeepak Dayal Patade vs The Commissioner Of Police And
Ors on 1 December, 2025

Author: Bharati Dangre
Bench: Bharati Dangre
 P.H. Jayani 
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Criminal Writ Petition No. 5348 Of 2024
 Surekha @ Saili Sandeep Sawant and Ors. 
 V/s.
 The State of Maharashtra and anr. 
 Mr. Vilas Mali for the Petitioners.
 Ms. Sangeeta Shinde, App for the Respondent - State.
 Coram : Bharati Dangre &
 Shyam C. Chandak
Dated : 01st December, 2025 P.C. :-
1) The Petition seek quashing of the subject Fir along with the charge-sheet invoking
Sections 498A, 323 and 504 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code against the
Petitioners at the instance of the Respondent No.2.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Issue notice to the Respondent No.2 by making it returnable on 17/12/2025.

In addition to the Court notice, the notice is also permitted to be served through private mode of service and since the charge-sheet is filed by Manpada Police Station, we permit the notice also to be served through the Officer-in-charge of Manpada Police Station.
Learned APP to communicate this Order to the concerned Police Station.

PREETI HEERO JAYANI (SHYAM C. CHANDAK, J.)
(BHARATI DANGRE, J.)
Nandeepak Dayal Patade vs The Commissioner Of Police And Ors
